missions.title: Morning walk
missions.brief: Stretch your legs. Walk down the street to the marker.

objectives.label: Walk to the marker

missions.title: Borrowed wheels
missions.brief: Your cousin left his hatchback on the street. Take it across town to Kilpauk Garden Road.

objectives.label: Get in the hatchback
Drive to Kilpauk Garden Road, Kilpauk

missions.title: Auto shift
missions.brief: Cover a friend's auto in Perambur for one fare. Pick the passenger up and drop them in Amirthammal Colony before they lose patience.

objectives.label: Get in the auto-rickshaw
Pick up the passenger
Drop the passenger

missions.title: Parcel run
missions.brief: Three parcels, three addresses between Chetpet and Nungambakkam, and the clock is running on each one.

objectives.label: Get in a car
Deliver parcel 1 of 3, Mc Nichols Road
Deliver parcel 2 of 3, Nungambakkam
Deliver parcel 3 of 3, Spur Tank Road

missions.title: Cross-town dash
missions.brief: Corner to corner across Anna Nagar, as fast as the streets allow.

objectives.label: Get in a car
Drive to the start line
Race to the finish

missions.title: Two-wheel courier
missions.brief: Lunch boxes go cold fast. Take the motorbike and make both drops on time.

objectives.label: Get on a motorbike
Collect the lunch boxes, Jeenis Road, Saidapet
First drop, Jothiammal Nagar
Second drop, Saidapet

missions.title: Park trouble
missions.brief: Three thugs are shaking down walkers in Tower Park. No weapons, just fists. Sort them out.

objectives.label: Go to Tower Park
Beat the three thugs (HIT)

missions.title: Bike thieves
missions.brief: A stolen motorbike is being stripped on a back street off Jawaharlal Nehru Road in Vadapalani, and two of the gang are armed. You have a pistol now: FIRE shoots where you look.

objectives.label: Find the thieves, off Jawaharlal Nehru Road
Take down the thieves
Get on a motorbike
Ride it back to its owner on Arcot Road

missions.title: Godown raid
missions.brief: The gang keeps its takings in a godown in the Ambattur Industrial Estate, far across town. Four guards, all armed. Use the corners.

objectives.label: Get to the godown, Ambit Park Road, Ambattur
Clear out the guards

missions.title: Roundtana showdown
missions.brief: The boss is waiting at the Roundtana with his best men. End it.

objectives.label: Go to the Roundtana
Defeat the boss and his men

missions.title: Courier chase
missions.brief: With the boss gone, three gangs want his streets. The Manjal Puli (Yellow Tigers) send a rider down Peters Road in Royapettah with the week's protection money. Take a car and stop him.

objectives.label: Go to Peters Road, Royapettah
Get in a car
Wait on Peters Road for the courier
Catch the courier: pull up beside him
Take the money back to the tea shop, Triplicane High Road

missions.title: Protection money
missions.brief: A tea shop owner in the Flower Bazaar paid the Manjal Puli for years. Now the Neela Nandu (Blue Crabs) want a cut too, and four of them are walking up the street. Stand with him. He keeps an old shotgun under the counter for you.

objectives.label: Wait at the tea shop, Audiappa Naicken Street
Send the racket packing

missions.title: Hot wheels
missions.brief: Word is out that you took the Neela Nandu's money. A friend left you a motorbike on KMS Street; the crew is waiting by it. Get on and ride for the Marina beach road.

objectives.label: Go to KMS Street, Triplicane
Get on the motorbike
Ride to the beach road before they get you

missions.title: Snake pit
missions.brief: The Pachai Paambu (Green Snakes) of Egmore have been arming both sides. Their hideout is a back street off Pantheon Road. Six of them, with shotguns and an SMG. Clear it out.

objectives.label: Find the hideout, Egmore
Clear out the hideout

missions.title: Turf war
missions.brief: The Manjal Puli boss has called every crew he has left to the bus junction in T. Nagar to finish this. So have you.

objectives.label: Go to the bus junction, T. Nagar
Win the turf war

missions.title: Biryani for the dressing room
missions.brief: Match day at Chepauk. A kitchen near Egmore station has forty parcels of biryani for the dressing room and its delivery rider has flu. The toss is soon: ride, and don't stop for tea.

objectives.label: Get on a motorbike
Collect the biryani near Egmore station
Deliver it to the stadium gate, Wallajah Road
Last box to the scorers, Victoria Hostel Road

missions.title: Muhurtham
missions.brief: Selvi akka's niece gets married in Mylapore this morning and the hired van never came. Three of the family are waiting on Westcott Road in their silks. Take the auto by the clock tower and get them to the mandapam before the muhurtham.

objectives.label: Get in the auto by the clock tower
Pick up the wedding party on Westcott Road
Get them to the mandapam on North Mada Street, Mylapore

missions.title: Hot property
missions.brief: Lakshmi, who sells jasmine by the temple near Elliot's Beach, wants a word. As she talks, someone slips a gold chain into your pocket and a constable starts shouting. Lose the police, then hand the chain in at the temple office.

objectives.label: Meet Lakshmi at her flower stall, Besant Nagar 2nd Avenue
Someone planted a stolen chain on you: lose the police
Hand the chain in at the temple office, Besant Nagar

missions.title: The Mumbai Mail
missions.brief: Padma Raghavan, a Carnatic singer with a concert in Mumbai tomorrow, has missed her ride and her train leaves Central soon. A car is parked on North Mada Street. Pick her up on South Mada Street and get her to Chennai Central.

objectives.label: Get in the car on North Mada Street
Pick up the singer on South Mada Street
Drop her at Chennai Central, EVR Periyar Salai

missions.title: Beach road brawl
missions.brief: A gang is robbing delivery riders on the beach road at Santhome. Five of them, bats and fists. Police patrols are thick on the beach road, so leave the guns holstered and settle it by hand.

objectives.label: Go to Kamarajar Salai, the beach road at Santhome
Beat the gang robbing the riders

missions.title: The harmonium thief
missions.brief: Padma's accompanist sent her harmonium ahead on a suburban train, and a thief has taken it off at Egmore. Walk to Park station, take the train one stop to Egmore, then catch him on the motorbike outside the station.

objectives.label: Walk to Park station
Take a train from Park to Chennai Egmore (BOARD on the platform)
Step off and get on the motorbike outside Egmore station
Catch the thief on EVR Periyar Salai
Bring the harmonium back to Egmore station

jobs.title: Ambulance run
jobs.brief: A patient needs a hospital now. Use the SIREN to clear the traffic, and drive smoothly: every bump hurts.

stops.label: Pick up the patient
Drive the patient to the hospital

jobs.title: Courier delivery
jobs.brief: Collect a parcel from the post office and get it across town on the motorbike. No damage earns a bonus.

stops.label: Collect the parcel at the post office, Vada Agaram Road, Choolaimedu
Deliver the parcel, NGO Colony

jobs.title: Cab ride
jobs.brief: A passenger is waiting for a car. The fare goes by distance; a smooth ride earns a tip.

stops.label: Pick up the passenger
Drop the passenger, Ayanavaram

jobs.title: Bus route
jobs.brief: Drive the city bus round its loop. Stop at every stop in order and keep to the timetable.

stops.label: Bus stop 1 of 4, Velachery Main Road, Guindy
Bus stop 2 of 4, Velachery Main Road
Bus stop 3 of 4, Velachery Main Road
Bus stop 4 of 4, Velachery Main Road

jobs.title: Hospital transfer
jobs.brief: A stable patient needs moving between hospitals for a scan. Less rush, but a smooth ride matters even more.

stops.label: Collect the patient at the hospital, Tank Bund Road, Mahalinga Puram
Transfer to the hospital

jobs.title: Lunch rush
jobs.brief: Three hot lunches from one kitchen to three homes. Ride fast, ride clean.

stops.label: Collect the orders, South Mada Street, Mylapore
Delivery 1 of 3, Santhome
Delivery 2 of 3, Devadi Street, Mylapore
Delivery 3 of 3, Mandaveli Road, Mylapore

jobs.title: Medicine run
jobs.brief: A hospital ward has run short. Take a box of medicine from the chemist, quickly.

stops.label: Collect the medicine, Tana street, Purasawalkam
Deliver to the hospital

jobs.title: Share auto
jobs.brief: Run a share auto down 2nd Avenue, Thirumangalam to Anna Nagar East. People wave it down anywhere: pull up beside them to let them in (4 seats), and stop where each one asks to get off. Fares are small (about ₹10 plus ₹5 a km each, estimated); missing a drop or passing people by costs reputation.

stops.label: End of the route at Anna Nagar East

jobs.title: Tower Park visitor
jobs.brief: A visitor wants to see Anna Nagar Tower Park before it closes. Take them to the gate.

stops.label: Pick up the visitor, Anna Salai (Mount Road), Teynampet
Drop them at the park gate, Poes Garden

jobs.title: Evening bus, the other way
jobs.brief: The same loop backwards at the busy hour. Tighter timetable, more people waiting.

stops.label: Bus stop 1 of 4, Avvai Thiru Nagar
Bus stop 2 of 4
Bus stop 3 of 4
Bus stop 4 of 4

jobs.title: Marina evening drive
jobs.brief: Take a friend from T. Nagar to Marina Beach for the evening breeze. Anna Salai is jammed at this hour: cross it, don't drive along it. Evenings only (16:00–20:30); the clock starts at the pick-up.

stops.label: Pick up your friend on Sir Thyagaraya Road, T. Nagar
Drop them at Marina Beach, on the beach road

jobs.title: Egmore hospital transfer
jobs.brief: A stable patient moves from a hospital in Egmore to one in Royapettah for treatment, through central Chennai. Use the SIREN; three bumps end the run.

stops.label: Collect the patient at the hospital on Pantheon Road, Egmore
Transfer to the hospital on Conron Smith Road, Royapettah

jobs.title: Mount Road bus
jobs.brief: Drive the bus up Anna Salai from Teynampet towards Thousand Lights, stopping at four real stops in order. Keep to the timetable in the heaviest traffic in town.

stops.label: Bus stop 1 of 4: SIET
Bus stop 2 of 4: DMS
Bus stop 3 of 4: US Embassy
Bus stop 4 of 4: Thousand Lights

stories.title: Paati's check-up
stories.brief: Your grandmother has a check-up at Sugam Hospital and has been ready since six in the morning. Drive her there, and home again before her TV serial starts.
stories.ending: Paati gives you ₹400 and the rest of her tiffin. The doctor's advice for you: fewer vadas.

steps.label: Get in a car: Paati is waiting
Drive Paati to Sugam Hospital. Gently: she is holding a tiffin box
Walk Paati in for her check-up (ENTER Sugam Hospital)
Drive Paati home before her serial starts

stories.title: Selva's gym bet
stories.brief: Your friend Selva bets you can't match his four good reps, then beat him to the juice shop on foot. Loser buys the sugarcane juice.
stories.ending: Selva pays for the juice and the bet, and books a rematch for next week.

steps.label: Match Selva: 4 good reps out of 5 (in the gym)
Race Selva to the juice shop, on foot

stories.title: First day, first show
stories.brief: Ravi got two tickets for the first show of a new film at Minnal Cinemas. Pick him up on the motorbike and get there before the hero's entry.
stories.ending: Ravi pays you back for the petrol. He has already booked the second show.

steps.label: Get on a motorbike: the show starts soon
Pick up Ravi (he is still choosing a shirt)
Ride to Minnal Cinemas before the hero's entry
Go in for the first show (ENTER Minnal Cinemas)
